# Queen Caroline

Queen Caroline may refer to:
* Caroline of Ansbach (1683–1737), queen consort of Great Britain and Ireland
* Caroline Matilda of Great Britain (1751–1775), queen consort of Denmark and Norway
* Maria Carolina of Austria (1752–1814), queen consort of Naples
* Caroline of Brunswick (1768–1821), queen consort of the United Kingdom and Hanover
* Caroline of Baden (1776–1841), queen consort of Bavaria
* Caroline Bonaparte (1782–1839), queen consort of Naples
* Caroline Augusta of Bavaria (1792–1873), queen consort of Hungary and Bohemia
* Caroline Amalie of Augustenburg (1796–1881), queen consort of Denmark
* Carola of Vasa (1833–1907), queen consort of Saxony
* Queen Caroline Estate, a council housing development in Hammersmith & Fulham, London
